title: Blaise (anifest 2026)

title_lang.zh_hk: 老尷這一家 (anifest動画藝術祭2026)

synopsis:
The Savage family is desperate to be loved. Carole knows her employees hate her and is determined to win them over at any cost; Jacques has never worked a day in his life and doesn’t feel respected; and their 16-year old introverted son Blaise is so happy with going along with everyone and agreeing to everything that he politely embarks on a revolutionary, violent, and completely impromptu crusade for a girl. Comic book artists Dimitri Planchon and Jean-Paul Guigue’s dry comedy of manners and misunderstandings is one of the most hilariously cringe-inducing films you’ll see all year.
